requirements.statement: Component dependency graph shall contain no cycles.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All missing references, self edges and directed cycles are rejected.

requirements.statement: Incoming message envelopes shall have validated UTC timestamps, source IDs and version.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Invalid versions, source IDs, timestamps and payload types are rejected.

requirements.statement: No remote actuation shall be enabled by the registry prototype.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: LifeCommand messages are rejected unconditionally.

requirements.statement: All requirements shall link to at least one existing component.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Empty, duplicate and dangling component references are rejected.
